question: What is the 4‑antenatal‑checkup coverage by district for the years 2021 to 2023, and what is the change in coverage from 2021 to 2023 for Gaya and Nalanda?

insights.message: The data do not provide information on why Gaya is below Nalanda. The dataset contains only coverage counts and does not include factors such as health infrastructure, socioeconomic status, or program implementation details.

view.title: ANC4 Coverage by District (2021‑2023)
view.note: Select a year to see coverage by district. The bars represent the percentage of pregnancies that completed at least 4 antenatal check‑ups. Source: synthetic Bihar ANC fixture – see the source tab for details.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The data are synthetic and may not reflect real‑world conditions.
